decision: Two new mineral owners ready for independent scientific review; no acceptance inferred from research or schema validation.
selection: Burbankite and synchysite-(Ce) supply distinct carbonate identities with accessible primary characterization. Burbankite also has bounded synthetic-analogue formation evidence. Ancylite variants remain uncurated leads for another round, not exhausted candidates.

identity_authority.inspected: Current homepage September 2026 link; PDF definitions page 1, Burbankite page 32 and Synchysite-(Ce) page 210 visually and textually checked. Formula and status distinct from chemical measurement. Burbankite G/1953; synchysite-Ce Rn/1982-030.
identity_authority.rights: Authority document retained externally; no complete list redistributed.

primary_sources.inspected: Complete 15-page original acquired; burbankite-bearing scope pp. 1169–1176 read and all corresponding page renders checked, including Tables 1–3 and Figures 1–2. Remaining calkinsite-specific section inspected as context, no calkinsite owner added.
primary_sources.claims: Natural mineral, geological setting, independent optical/powder/single-crystal characterization; approximate96% grain-count purity, impurity-adjusted chemistry, qualitative cold1:5HCl effervescence.
primary_sources.limits: Old P63/mmc assignment is historical and not treated as a present structural standard. Mixed weathered assemblage does not establish a unique reaction pathway; adjusted elemental composition is not direct pure-phase assay. No rate, yield, microbial or industrial inference.
primary_sources.rights: Historical article retained only outsideGit; bibliographic citation and paraphrases committed.

primary_sources.inspected: Full 8-page primary, Methods/Results/Discussion; all Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–6, corresponding PDF renders. Complete official supplement 7 pages Tables S1–S4/Figs. S1–S3 and supplied CIF examined.
primary_sources.claims: NominalNa3Ca2La(CO3)5 powders in sealed3.5mm×2mmPt capsule,5GPa/1073K/24h,about40Kmin−1;temperature±20K,pressure±3%; mixed carbonate+Ca-rich La oxide assemblage.20 EMPApoints are not20 synthesisreplicates. Ambient structureP63mc; no yield quantified.
primary_sources.limits: Synthetic La/Ca composition is explicitly an analogue, not composition of natural Montana specimens. Five-oxygen normalization is not explicitly labelled as a metal-oxide-only basis, which could explain the wording without an erroneous carbonate formula; Na uncertainty prose/CIF(14) vsTable 1(13). Thermal abstract coefficients6.0(2)e−5/5.7(7)e−8/V0=591.95(8), Results6.4(1)e−5/3.3(5)e−8/V0=591.86(4). Abstract/methods746K vs Table 5/S4/Fig. S3 stopping628K. Discussion1731–1273K vs abstract1173–1273K. These disputed quantitative interpretations are excluded. CIF formula-unit metadata are retained for later verification, not imported.
primary_sources.rights: Publisher CC BY 4.0; original PDF/SI remain external, claims paraphrased.

primary_sources.inspected: Complete 15-pageprimary and integrated Appendix A read; allTables 1–4/A1–A3 and Figures 1–5/A1 visually checked, including sample-to-method mapping and chemistry means/spotcounts. PublisherXML acquired to check text.
primary_sources.claims: Five Cuasso al Monte crystals, four SCXRD structures, separate FCBN2/3SEM and FCBN5TEM. Accepted FCBN3 Ce0.44core (13 spots) and0.30outer rim (11 spots) on a two-cation basis. Ideal CaCe(CO3)2F is distinct from observed zoning.
primary_sources.limits: Fictitious site occupancies/calculated densities not measured chemistry; low F may be beam diffusion. Diffuse scattering, inclusions, disorder and FIB/beam effects limit microstructure causality. Screw-dislocation hypothesis is explicitly qualified and its radial-zoning conflict retained in paper. FCF files request-only/not acquired. No separate supplement linked; failed guessed ZIP 404 retained, not called missing required SI.
primary_sources.rights: Publisher CC BY 4.0; original PDF/XML retained externally.
